name: Limitless Nexus
description: Nexus build/test repository for Limitless providers. Active playable providers follow the canonical root-level NAMING_STANDARDS.md quality/audio/subtitle/mirror scheme; unknown stream classes are labeled [UNK] instead of guessed.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider with season-aware TMDB-to-AniList matching for TV seasons above Season 1, shared anime identity fallbacks, Season 0 specials handling, and evidence-based Nexus quality/audio/subtitle labels. Later seasons fail closed instead of silently falling back to Season 1.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: WCO production provider with mirror coverage, strict title/episode ownership, anime identity support, specials handling, Power Rangers mapping, and evidence-based Nexus quality/audio/subtitle labels.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: Tubi

scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus Tubi provider

scrapers.name: NetMirror

scrapers.name: Vidlink

scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus; control behavior reference: Eclipsia Haylox/Vidlink
